room.name: Take It Back
room.hint: Dash out for each tally · Hold the opposite direction and Jump during the dash.
room.question: Which direction must the dash begin, and which direction must its jump leave?

bank.author: Codex
bank.solution: Two opposed outgoing dashes collect the tallies outside the supports. Reverse each dash jump toward the next phase shelf. The second rising return reaches the upper eastern exit.
bank.nearestExisting: p005 phase-floor departures and the Switchback phase rooms use the dash to change terrain; this makes the outward contact and the return jump disagree in direction twice.
bank.novelty: The direction required to touch each tally points away from the landing. Reversing preserves a useful jump launch while the same dash changes which shore exists.
bank.hintTeaching: An outgoing dash and its jump can now point in opposite directions: hold Left or Right when pressing Jump. Let the dash collect the outside tally first.
bank.designNotes: The canonical route uses two reversals. A carefully positioned ordinary super that solves the same phase and trajectory problem is a legitimate advanced alternative, not ruled out by an arbitrary route lock.
